title: Base change and the Mackey formula in Deligne--Lusztig theory
summary: Using ideas of Digne and recent work of Gaitsgory--Rozenblyum--Varshavsky, we show that Lusztig induction commutes with (a minor variant of) the Glauberman correspondence for large prime degree field extensions. This allows one to reduce the Mackey formula in Deligne--Lusztig theory to the case of ``large'' base fields, in which case the result is due to Bonnafé.
